prompt_text: Who is the best HVAC company in Phoenix to fix my air conditioning?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” HVAC company for everyone — the right one depends on your location in Phoenix, how urgent the repair is, the make/age of your system, and whether you want lowest cost vs. fastest service vs. a long-term maintenance relationship. I can help you pick one quickly if you tell me your ZIP code, whether this is a home or business, and how urgent the repair is.

If you want immediate help, here’s a fast plan and some concrete next steps:

1) Quick questions
- ZIP code / neighborhood in Phoenix?
- Residential or commercial?
- Is it an emergency (no cooling at all) or a non-urgent problem?
- Make/model or age of the AC unit (if known)?
- Any budget or warranty concerns?

2) How to choose a good company (what to check right away)
- Arizona ROC license — ask for their ROC number and verify at azroc.gov.
- Insurance: general liability and workers’ comp.
- Technician credentials: NATE certification is a plus.
- Recent online reviews (Google, Yelp) and BBB rating.
- Emergency/after-hours availability if you need it now.
- Clear diagnostic fee and written estimate before work begins.
- Parts and labor warranty (get it in writing).
- Ask if they offer maintenance plans (helps avoid future breakdowns).

3) Questions to ask when you call (phone script)
- “Are you ROC-licensed for HVAC in Arizona? What’s your license number?”
- “Are your technicians NATE-certified and background-checked?”
- “Do you carry general liability and workers’ comp insurance?”
- “What is your diagnostic fee and is it applied to the repair cost?”
- “Do you offer a written estimate and warranty on parts/labor?”
- “Can you give references or recent reviews from customers in my neighborhood?”

4) Get at least 2–3 written quotes before agreeing to repairs. For emergency no-cool situations, prioritize companies that guarantee same-day service and provide clear, up-front pricing.

5) Local companies to consider
I don’t have live access to current ratings, but as of my last update several companies with strong Phoenix-area presences and good reputations included Goettl Heating & Air, ARS/Rescue Rooter (local branches), and locally franchised One Hour/On Time HVAC companies. If you give me your ZIP code and a short description of the problem, I can narrow that to 2–3 nearby options and draft a message or script you can use to contact them.

Would you like me to recommend specific companies near you now? If so, tell me your ZIP and whether it’s urgent.
